title: API & Webhook Documentation
subtitle: Create orders, push them to production and receive status notifications straight from your own system.

start.authDesc: Send the <1>X-Api-Key</1> header with an API key of the form <1>onos_live_…</1> on every request. Create keys on the API & Webhook page — the full key is shown exactly ONCE at creation, and up to {{max}} keys can be active at a time.
start.contentType: Request bodies are JSON — always send the <1>Content-Type: application/json</1> header.
start.scope: The API can only see and act on orders belonging to the account that owns the key.

flow.step1: <0>Create orders</0> — orders land in Pending (not yet in production). Every item is immediately assigned a <2>productionId</2> of the form XX-#####-##### used for tracking end-to-end.
flow.step2: <0>Push to production</0> — call push with your order refs. Prices are locked and the order enters the factory; after this only designs/address can be edited (stage-dependent).
flow.step3: <0>Track</0> — register a Webhook for push-based events (recommended), or poll the lookup endpoint.

endpoints.createDesc: Create Pending orders in batch (up to {{max}} orders/call) — idempotent by externalRef
endpoints.pushDesc: Push orders to production by externalRefs or ids
endpoints.listDesc: List the account's orders (8 derived statuses + held/rework badges)
endpoints.getDesc: Look up one order by externalRef or productionId — status + production journey

create.intro: Create up to {{max}} orders per call. Each order holds up to 100 items. At most 500 item lines total per call.
create.idempotent: Idempotent by <1>externalRef</1>: calling again with the same ref returns <1>duplicated</1> — nothing is created twice and the existing order is NOT modified. To edit a Pending order, use the Customer Portal.
create.wholeFail: If any item line in an order is invalid (unknown SKU, discontinued product…), that WHOLE order is rejected (other orders in the batch still process normally).
create.itemFieldsTitle: items[] — each product in the order

fields.externalRef: Your system's order reference — idempotency key, reused for push and lookup.
fields.orderName: Friendly order name (shown on the portal).

address.firstName: Recipient name (full name is fine here).

item.sku: Variant SKU from the OnosFactory catalog — must match EXACTLY (case-insensitive). Unknown SKUs or discontinued products reject the order.
item.shipMethod: Shipping method: cod | express_us | economy_us | tiktok.
item.activeService: USPS Active service — only applies to express_us.
item.mockupUrl: Product mockup image URL. Optional at creation but REQUIRED at push time — missing mockups fail the push.
item.designs: Design files per print area — see the Designs section below.
item.tracking: A shipment YOU provide (pre-purchased label) — see the Tracking section below.
item.rawItemName: Product name in your system — reference only, not the source of truth.
item.rawColor: Color in your system — reference only.
item.rawSize: Size in your system — reference only.

create.designsTitle: designs — design files by print area
create.designsDesc: An object keyed by print area, values are design file URLs (publicly downloadable — Google Drive share links or direct URLs). Supported keys:
create.designsRule: Rule: products printed on the front/back only need at least 1 design at <1>front</1> OR <1>back</1>. Products printed elsewhere need at least 1 design on one of that product's required print areas. Enforced at PUSH time — orders missing designs fail with a reason and are not pushed.
create.trackingDesc: Fill this in when you already bought a label elsewhere (e.g. Ship by TikTok): the system will NOT create a new shipment, and your label is printed and attached at the Packing stage. With shipMethod = tiktok you MUST provide tracking + label.

tracking.labelUrl: Label file URL (PDF/image) for the factory to print.

create.responseNote: One result row per order: <1>created</1>, <1>duplicated</1> (externalRef already exists — skipped), or <1>failed</1> (with error and per-index itemErrors).

push.intro: Push Pending orders into production. Select orders by <1>externalRefs</1> (your refs) or <1>ids</1> (staging _id from the list endpoint) — at least one of the two, each array up to {{max}} entries.

fields.externalRefs: Array of your order refs (externalRef at creation).

notes.whole: Orders are pushed WHOLE — individual items cannot be pushed separately.
notes.artwork: Missing-mockup / missing-design gate (see the rules under Create orders) — orders missing artwork return failed with a reason; other orders still push.
notes.idempotent: Orders already pushed or currently pushing are never pushed twice.
notes.price: Prices are locked using the price list + tier promotions at push time; the grand total is returned in totalAmount.

list.intro: Returns a paginated list, newest first. Order status is derived from the real production progress of each item.

params.status: Filter by status: pending | processing | in-production | fulfilled | completed | refunded | cancelled.
params.held: true = only orders currently On Hold.
params.search: Search by your order ref / order name / productionId.

get.intro: <1>:ref</1> accepts an order's externalRef OR an item's productionId. The response always contains <1>order</1> (order + items + status); when :ref is the productionId of a PUSHED item it also contains <1>track</1> — that item's detailed production journey (stages + timestamps).

webhook.intro: Register receiver URLs on the API & Webhook page (up to {{max}} URLs, http/https). Every webhook has a <1>secret</1> of the form whsec_… for signature verification. Selecting no events = receive ALL of them.

events.held: Item put on hold (waiting for design / address…).
events.unheld: Item released from hold, production resumes.

delivery.post: JSON POST to your URL, 5-second timeout, redirects are not followed.
delivery.retry: On failure (non-2xx / timeout) we retry up to 2 times after 5s and 25s, then give up. Your endpoint should return 2xx IMMEDIATELY and process asynchronously.
delivery.perItem: Events fire PER item (one delivery per productionId).
delivery.dedupe: Use the X-Onos-Delivery header (unique per delivery) to deduplicate when retries occur.

headers.signature: Signature sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw body, keyed with the webhook secret>.

webhook.payloadNote: data always contains productionId; some events add extra fields (e.g. hold reason / cancel reason).
webhook.verifyDesc: Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the RAW body (the original byte string, before JSON parsing) with the webhook secret and compare with the X-Onos-Signature header:

errors.intro: Error responses look like { "success": false, "message": "…" } (validation errors return per-field details).

rows.e400: Business errors: missing mockup / missing designs at push, order not eligible…
rows.e422: Body fails the schema (missing required fields, wrong types, length limits, empty SKU…) — includes per-field details.
rows.e401: Missing / invalid / revoked API key, or account locked. Generic message by design — no details are revealed.
rows.e429: Rate limit exceeded — enforced PER key and PER account (extra keys don't multiply your quota). Check the X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset (seconds) headers and retry later.
